architecture_conclusion.text: The provisional peak V554 is a narrow reference-composed structural-affordance compiler. It composes exact original producer-owned structural facts, admission/use permission and governed authority with exact V553 temporal objects only when the V554 rule requires temporal meaning, then creates only bounded downstream mediation-input eligibility, explicit unresolved structural requirements, typed limits/negative authority and an exact-reference V555 handoff. It does not recompute structural pressure, reconstruct temporal identity from aggregates, choose mediation routes, instantiate receiving actors, or create person/household/psyche/biography facts.

strengthened: Specified five semantic object families with row grains and fields.
Specified deterministic stable-ID and typed-reference principles.
Specified canonical affordance lifecycle and fail-closed precedence.
Specified five dependency-ordered eventual implementation packets.
narrowed: Reviewable is metadata/unresolved authority context, not an affirmative permission state.
AFFORDANCE_RELATION is optional and disabled/valid-empty absent a governed relation rule.
No canonical V554-specific numeric strength/confidence/specificity/certifiability score is accepted absent a separately governed formula and interpretation.
rejected_current_semantics: hardcoded universal mediation slots as V554 authority
parallel generic-thin and specialized semantic authorities

formal_jurisdiction.unique_question: May this exact governed structural condition serve as a V555 structural mediation input, under what structural constraints, with what unresolved requirements and what explicit limits?

Did an actor encounter, absorb, resist, transmit or transform a pressure?
What memory, motive, biography, psyche, voice or attractor does the actor have?

components.name: SemanticInputSelectorAndAuthorityResolver
components.law: Select only the original producer-owned meanings required by the explicit V554 rule; never upgrade reviewability, confidence, harmonization, readiness or file presence into authority.

components.name: BoundedAffordanceDerivationEngine
components.law: Only component that creates positive V554 semantic meaning. Every row requires rule_id + rule_version. Recommended initial affordance kind is structural_mediation_input. No numeric V554 score by default.

components.name: StructuralRequirementAndPositionConstraintResolver
components.law: Bind existing governed structural position constraints or publish typed unresolved requirements with a resolution owner; never instantiate actor occupancy, household, parent, child or membership facts.

components.name: NegativeAuthorityAndOptionalRelationResolver
components.law: Merge absence/blocker/prohibition into one typed limit model. AFFORDANCE_RELATION defaults disabled/valid-empty absent governed relation authority.

components.name: V555CompositionHandoffPublisher
components.law: One thin consumer binding per affordance; expose exact refs, states, requirements and limits without copying producer-owned values or selecting mediation channels.

components.name: PublicationManifestAndCompletionCourt
components.law: Write canonical allowlist, hashes/schema/rule versions and finite readiness verdict. Valid-empty may complete successfully.

input_selection.candidate_discovery: Rule-driven, never file-presence-driven. Each rule declares eligible producer family, exact grain, target use, required authority, temporal requirement, applicability predicate, structural-position needs, negative-state behavior and valid-empty behavior.

semantic_families.name: BOUNDED_STRUCTURAL_AFFORDANCE
semantic_families.row_grain: rule/version x exact source structural anchor x exact governed scope x target downstream use; exact temporal identity participates when the rule is temporal
semantic_families.meaning: Bounded permission/eligibility state for an exact structural condition to function as a V555 structural mediation input; no route or actor realization.

semantic_families.name: STRUCTURAL_MEDIATION_REQUIREMENT
semantic_families.row_grain: one rule-grounded structural requirement attached to one affordance
semantic_families.jurisdiction: Missing receiving-position authority becomes a typed unresolved requirement, never a fabricated parent/household/child/carrier actor fact.

semantic_families.name: V554_LIMIT
semantic_families.row_grain: one typed negative/constraint state affecting a candidate, affordance, handoff use or publication
semantic_families.special_law: Measured zero is not a limit. Valid-empty is a run/publication state, not a pseudo-affordance.

semantic_families.name: AFFORDANCE_RELATION
semantic_families.row_grain: one explicit governed relation among two or more affordance IDs within an exact scope

semantic_families.name: V554_V555_HANDOFF
semantic_families.row_grain: one consumer binding per V554 affordance visible to V555
semantic_families.law: V554 does not select a V555 mediation channel/route.
